title: Text: DET Jordan Zimmermann ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What’s your workout like tomorrow? Can I get you on my podcast when you’re done for the day?
I’d probably be done by noon
Tell me more about this potcast?
It’s basically just in-depth conversations on a wide range of interesting topics, hosted by me
What are the interesting topics before I dive in and say yes
Do you throw a bullpen tomorrow?
Let’s do it Tuesday, then. Interesting topics include: Your bullpen session, my pitching mechanics, if a hot Dog is a sandwich and these new rule changes that are being floated out there
Tuesday I’m booked full. I have things going on 12-3
Ok, tomorrow is fine. See you then
